components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action control for creation, saving, generating schedules, and confirming competitive flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Chakra Petch, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #22C55E 0%, #16A34A 100%); border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 24px; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.25); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4ADE80 0%, #22C55E 100%); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.35); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.32); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Secondary action control for alternate tournament or navigation choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { font-family: Chakra Petch, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #F8FAFC; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 24px; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { border-color: #22C55E; background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.05); } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.25); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-card { font-family: Chakra Petch, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif; color: #F8FAFC; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6); border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.08); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); transition: border-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 250ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), 0 0 0 1px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.1); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 1.1rem; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #94A3B8; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-card .ds-card-kicker { margin-bottom: 8px; color: #4ADE80; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Dark slate input for PINs, player names, teams, and match result forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: Chakra Petch, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif; color: #F8FAFC; } .ds-field span { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; color: #94A3B8; } .ds-field input { color: #F8FAFC; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5); border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font: inherit; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #64748B; opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #22C55E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.1); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Desktop navigation item with clear selected state for app sections.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: Chakra Petch, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; color: #B7C4D6; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px; text-align: left; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.07); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.25); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item-active { color: #ECFDF5; background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2); border-color: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.55); box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.9), 0 0 22px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.13); } .ds-nav-item span { color: #4ADE80; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact state or filter pill for formats, awards, selected players, and match metadata.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: Chakra Petch, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #F8FAFC; background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12); border-radius: 999px; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.35); color: #4ADE80; }

narrative.overview:
FC Tournament Tracker should feel like a private competitive command center for a friend group: dark, focused, energetic, and exact. The system uses a deep navy-black field, electric pitch-green state color, and compact technical typography to make tournaments feel live without turning every screen into decoration.

The interface is product-first. Tables, forms, standings, brackets, player cards, and analytics panels must be readable under match-night pressure. The visual drama comes from hierarchy, ranking, current state, rivalry context, and selective glow, not from generic esports clutter.
keyCharacteristics: Dark OLED-style surfaces with layered slate panels.
Primary green reserved for action, selection, success, and live competitive status.
Electric blue used as a secondary analytical accent, never as a competing CTA.
Chakra Petch across the product for a technical match-broadcast voice.
Glass and glow used sparingly to separate active surfaces from dense data.

rules.name: The Green Means Action Rule
rules.body: Pitchline Green is reserved for actions, active state, success, and live competitive meaning. Never spray it across inactive decoration.

rules.name: The No Generic Dashboard Rule
rules.body: Do not reduce the palette to interchangeable dark cards and blue charts. Every highlight must explain a tournament, rivalry, form, or match state.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Chakra Petch owns the interface. Do not add a second decorative font unless a future redesign deliberately replaces the whole type system.

rules.name: The Data First Rule
rules.body: Dense labels can be small, but scores, ranks, standings, and form indicators must remain optically louder than surrounding chrome.

rules.name: The State Earns Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow belongs to active, hover, focus, selected, success, or primary action states. Static ornament glow is prohibited.

dos: Do preserve the competitive control-room atmosphere: Stadium Black, Panel Slate, Pitchline Green, and Chakra Petch are the core identity.
Do use green to clarify actions, active state, success, rankings, and live competitive meaning.
Do make standings, scores, records, and form indicators louder than decorative chrome.
Do pair color-coded status with labels, icons, order, or copy so the meaning survives color-blindness and low contrast.
Do respect reduced motion; glow and reveal effects must have non-disruptive alternatives.
donts: Don't let the app feel generic.
Don't use anonymous SaaS dashboard patterns, bland chart panels, or interchangeable card grids.
Don't use decorative esports styling that does not help users understand tournaments, rivalries, form, or match state.
Don't add gradient text or colored side-stripe borders.
Don't use static glassmorphism as filler. Glass is allowed only when it improves hierarchy, separation, or active context.
